name: JLC Footprint Importer
description: Import LCSC/JLCPCB parts (symbol, footprint, 3D model) into a project-local library.
description_full: Adds an Import LCSC part action to the PCB editor. Enter an LCSC part number (e.g. C1002) and the symbol, footprint and 3D model are fetched with easyeda2kicad into a project-local 'jlc' library, which is registered in the project's library tables. Offers KiCad's stock chip footprints (R/C/L/LED/D) first where one fits, skips parts already imported, refuses same-named footprints whose pads differ, and records the LCSC ID, source and import date on every imported part. Needs internet access. Note: EasyEDA/LCSC-sourced footprints have no clear open licence, so prefer KiCad's stock footprints where one exists. Requires the KiCad IPC API to be enabled; the plugin creates its own Python environment on first use.
